description.en: The ID of the backup plan. To get this ID, call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request.

description.zh: 仅关闭MySQL物理备份的日志备份
description.en: Specifies whether to disable only the log backup feature for a physical backup of a MySQL database.

descriptions.zh:
## 影响
关闭后，您的备份计划将不再进行增量备份。
descriptions.en:
## Impact

Calling this operation stops the specified backup plan from creating new incremental backups.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs disable-backup-log --backup-plan-id dbstooi010000 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCziJZNwH0000 --disable-mysql-physical-backup-binlog-only false --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs DisableBackupLog --region cn-hangzhou --DisableMysqlPhysicalBackupBinlogOnly false --BackupPlanId dbstooi010000 --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCziJZNwH0000
